objective: Research accessibility tagging and PDF specifications, select 50 improvements, and implement and verify all 50.
completionRule: All 50 independently implemented and verified against their acceptance criteria. Existing features, planning, abstention alone for a requested supported case, and validator-count reductions alone do not establish completion.

items.requirement: Keep source operator indices exact when PDFBox dispatches virtual TD/TL operations.
items.acceptance: Mixed positioning/text fixture indices equal an independent PDFStreamParser token walk.

items.requirement: Treat single-quote and double-quote text showing as one source operation each.
items.acceptance: Quote operators decode complete text once and subsequent native tags own the correct glyphs.

items.requirement: Report Form XObject invocation paths separately from page text operators.
items.acceptance: Nested/reused Forms carry stable invocation identities; no child operator impersonates page text.

items.requirement: Tag text in nested and reused Form XObjects with invocation-specific ownership.
items.acceptance: Saved text in two differently transformed invocations has correct owners and unchanged pixels.

items.requirement: Write stream references and scoped ParentTree entries for non-page content.
items.acceptance: Identical MCID numbers in different streams resolve to their own structure elements.

items.requirement: Attach a marker-only source operator to Lbl and following content to LBody.
items.acceptance: Separate marker/body operands yield nonempty saved Lbl and LBody without moving glyphs.

items.requirement: Split qualified TJ list markers while retaining all positioning adjustments.
items.acceptance: Mixed string/number TJ arrays preserve advances, bytes and distinct label/body ownership.

items.requirement: Partition one source text operation across multiple intended label/value nodes.
items.acceptance: Booklet label/value examples attach to exact intended nodes; spacing and geometry are unchanged.

items.requirement: Expose verified byte boundaries for multibyte codes, ligatures and Unicode sequences.
items.acceptance: Splitting never bisects a font code or Unicode mapping; ambiguous boundaries are rejected.

items.requirement: Retain optional-content wrappers during retagging.
items.acceptance: Default visibility and alternate layer states render identically; generated MCIDs remain balanced.

items.requirement: Carry valid source ActualText/expansion semantics through native rebuilding.
items.acceptance: Authored ligature and abbreviation replacement survives without duplicating or suppressing unrelated text.

items.requirement: Retain evidenced pagination/background artifact properties without hiding meaningful content.
items.acceptance: Saved pagination/artifact metadata survives, while identically styled body text remains semantic.

items.requirement: Normalize extraction, matching and saved geometry for nonzero/negative crop origins.
items.acceptance: Shifted-crop fixtures attach all intended text and retain page geometry and pixels.

items.requirement: Use a consistent coordinate convention for PDFs with non-default UserUnit.
items.acceptance: Scaled-unit fixtures preserve coordinates across text, annotations and matching without double scaling.

items.requirement: Order semantic content in the actual display frame across page rotations.
items.acceptance: Rotated multicolumn pages have expected saved order at 0/90/180/270 degrees.

items.requirement: Prevent paragraph merging across adjacent label/value columns.
items.acceptance: Booklet launch details and acronym rows retain distinct identities and logical pair order.

items.requirement: Distinguish repeated headers/footers from repeated meaningful body text.
items.acceptance: Location-varying pagination is recognized; body repetitions and section titles are retained.

items.requirement: Separate section numbering from decimals, dates and numbered list items.
items.acceptance: Adversarial numeric examples keep their correct roles while evidenced numbered headings remain headings.

items.requirement: Improve heading continuation across mixed fonts and adjacent subtitles.
items.acceptance: A heading wraps completely without swallowing a differently ranked subtitle or body line.

items.requirement: Keep section containers consistent with corrected heading ranks and membership.
items.acceptance: Saved nested sections agree with the approved outline after heading demotion and rank refinement.

items.requirement: Verify that every saved MCR points to a real marked-content sequence.
items.acceptance: Deleting or changing a sequence makes saved comparison fail, even when its MCR dictionary remains.

items.requirement: Require meaningful owned content rather than an empty MCID wrapper.
items.acceptance: Empty and whitespace-only wrappers cannot satisfy intended nonempty text attachment.

items.requirement: Detect duplicate and foreign ownership of painted source content.
items.acceptance: Wrong-owner and multiply-owned glyph mutations fail despite unchanged structure IDs.

items.requirement: Verify reciprocal ownership across page, Form and annotation scopes.
items.acceptance: Cross-stream and annotation-key mutations fail; valid reused MCIDs in separate scopes pass.

items.requirement: Compare intended source identities against the actual saved glyph coverage.
items.acceptance: Partial substring matches cannot pass complete text; bounded replacement-text exceptions carry proof.

items.requirement: Map OCR coordinates through crop, rotation and render scale exactly once.
items.acceptance: Known image text boxes land correctly on rotated/cropped pages at multiple render resolutions.

items.requirement: Insert a tagged invisible text layer for accepted OCR on image-only pages.
items.acceptance: Official poster and synthetic scans expose saved text with complete ownership and unchanged images.

items.requirement: Attach OCR-only regions without duplicating native text or losing conflicts.
items.acceptance: Booklet mixed page gains OCR attachments; overlapping native/OCR conflicts remain explicit review tasks.

items.requirement: Embed verified OCR fonts and preserve Unicode for characters outside the first font.
items.acceptance: Accents, symbols and missing-glyph cases have correct extracted text or explicit failure, never replacement boxes.

items.requirement: Carry word-level uncertainty and corrections through to saved output qualification.
items.acceptance: Low-confidence text cannot be silently accepted; hash-bound corrections change only intended text metadata/layer.

items.requirement: Qualify missing mappings using the existing embedded TrueType program.
items.acceptance: Booklet mapping failures reduce only with proven used-code/GID equivalence and pixel preservation.

items.requirement: Repair supported symbolic-font Unicode mappings using verified glyph evidence.
items.acceptance: Wingdings-like cases produce correct Unicode for observed glyphs; unsupported ambiguity stays unresolved.

items.requirement: Recover missing programs only from verified matching donor programs and metrics.
items.acceptance: Exact-donor fixtures embed correctly; similar-family substitutions and mismatched advances are refused.

items.requirement: Distinguish absent, malformed and contradictory mappings with bounded repair.
items.acceptance: Malformed maps are diagnosed per used code; verified replacements preserve glyph selection and extraction.

items.requirement: Extend form-default font qualification to new input and non-ASCII supported glyphs.
items.acceptance: Fill/save/reopen retains field values and appearance for verified repertoire; unsupported glyphs are reported.

items.requirement: Bind native Link tags, annotation OBJRs and ParentTree entries to source anchor text.
items.acceptance: New native output has reciprocal link ownership with unchanged action, rectangle and appearance.

items.requirement: Associate rotated and multiline link geometry in a consistent coordinate frame.
items.acceptance: QuadPoints/rotation fixtures bind the correct anchor and preserve actions; nearby text is excluded.

items.requirement: Group multiple anchor text runs under one appropriate Link structure element.
items.acceptance: Wrapped anchors retain ordered text and one annotation reference without stealing neighboring runs.

items.requirement: Create hierarchical bookmarks from an accepted document outline.
items.acceptance: Unicode titles, page targets and hierarchy round-trip correctly; existing authored bookmarks are preserved.

items.requirement: Include page labels and outline destinations in saved preservation qualification.
items.acceptance: Mutated Roman/decimal labels or bookmark destinations fail preservation; unchanged labels pass.

items.requirement: Detect and resolve inconsistent row/column spans before inventing grid positions.
items.acceptance: Overlapping spans generate a bounded repair/review result; valid merged grids serialize unchanged.

items.requirement: Improve corner and multirow header association with explicit scope evidence.
items.acceptance: Reviewed mixed-header fixtures expose correct Headers relations with no unrelated header targets.

items.requirement: Keep repeated header occurrences and continuation references scoped correctly.
items.acceptance: A continued table retains all page header occurrences and associates each body cell with the correct headers.

items.requirement: Prevent diagram label alignments from becoming false tables.
items.acceptance: Booklet diagrams and negative fixtures retain meaningful figure/text grouping; genuine aligned tables still work.

items.requirement: Save evidence-backed Table/Figure caption relationships in correct reading order.
items.acceptance: Caption association survives output and does not attach neighboring unrelated prose.

items.requirement: Attach every native form widget to the intended Form structure without rebuilding controls.
items.acceptance: Multiwidget fields have reciprocal OBJRs and unchanged names, values, actions and appearance streams.

items.requirement: Apply accepted missing-name associations through a hash-bound qualified repair.
items.acceptance: Only reviewed missing TU names change; existing names and form behavior remain intact.

items.requirement: Preserve group identity while exposing distinct choice labels and export states.
items.acceptance: Radio groups expose reviewed names/choices and still select, save and reopen correctly.

items.requirement: Qualify structure-based form navigation across multiline, repeated and hidden widgets.
items.acceptance: All eligible widgets occur once in expected order; hidden widgets and noninteractive labels are handled explicitly.

items.requirement: Integrate source coverage, semantic failures and preservation into final candidate eligibility.
items.acceptance: Stale, partial or failed evidence cannot publish a qualified result; complete machine evidence still requires human review.
